environment.buildProfileRule: Child USERPROFILE is bound to the parent of the pinned Cargo home; the invoking process environment remains unchanged.

changes: Runtime responses are streamed into bounded decoded-byte buffers; the whole response is never read with arrayBuffer.
Manifest remains at most 16384 bytes; WASM destination uses the exact normalized manifest byteCount, capped at 16777216.
Wire Content-Length is checked as an integer but is not substituted for decoded length when Content-Encoding is present.
Overflow, malformed/empty streams, and read failures cancel the reader without awaiting cancellation; every owned reader lock is released.
Canonical manifest, exact final WASM byte count, SHA-256 and WebAssembly validation remain required.
Runtime build checks allocate marked scratch in canonical artifacts instead of E:\Source\.codex-tmp.
Scratch cleanup permits hard-link aliases only when all names for each device/inode are present within that exact owned tree; external aliases and symlinks remain rejected.
Build failures are cached and preserved alongside any cleanup failure; isolated virtual profile mapping uses the pinned toolchain owner.
